name: Beached Sea Creature
summary: Along Darkshore, a great sea mammal lies half-devoured on the sand. Murlocs gather around it, and Priestess Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine seeks bone samples to learn why gentle sea beasts are dying on the shore.

sections.title: A Gruesome Shoreline Discovery
sections.body: Far north along Darkshore's lonely beaches, a great sea mammal lies rotting and half-eaten. Murlocs pick over its bones, more vicious than usual. These beasts were gentle in life, and their deaths trouble the coast as much as the blighted forests inland.

sections.title: Uncharacteristic Stranding
sections.body: Priestess Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde says these gentle mammals live in the waters around Teldrassil's base. Unlike aggressive threshers, they have never been known to drive themselves onto the rocks. The Temple of the Moon is gathering bone samples to learn what corruption or threat drives them from the deep.

faq.q: What kind of creature washed up here?
faq.answer: The remains are those of a large, gentle sea mammal that usually lives in the deep waters around Teldrassil's base. These peaceful giants do not usually beach themselves.

faq.q: Why did the sea creature beach itself?
faq.answer: No one knows why the sea creature beached itself. Priestess Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde says such strandings are unnatural for this species, and night elf researchers suspect a disturbance or corruption in the seas is disorienting them or driving them from their home waters.
Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a Temple of the Moon priestess stationed in Auberdine. She is coordinating an inquiry into the coastline, gathering bones to study the affliction harming local sea life.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the corpse?
faq.answer: The murlocs have gathered around the corpse for an easy meal. This band is stronger and more aggressive than murlocs living closer to Auberdine.

faq.q: Where does this creature normally live?
faq.answer: These sea mammals live in the open waters around Teldrassil's great boughs and roots. In ordinary times, they rarely approach the mainland shore.

faq.q: How does this relate to other beachings in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Several kinds of sea life have washed ashore along Darkshore, including carnivorous threshers and giant sea turtles. Threshers are naturally turbulent, but gentle mammals beaching themselves shows that the trouble affects species across the coastal ecosystem.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, these strandings wound their reverence for natural harmony. The waters around their new home of Teldrassil are growing troubled.
The Temple of the Moon oversees this inquiry and seeks divine insight into the corruption troubling Kalimdor's waters.
For the Cenarion Circle, any change in sea life is a dire omen of an unnatural blight poisoning coastal wildlife.
Protecting the shores around Auberdine helps secure Alliance shipping lanes between Darkshore, Teldrassil, and the eastern kingdoms.
